text:
ellie: CI flakes when running the ruby sampleapp on GH actions -- failure is an SSL verify error during the initial token fetch. stack: `SSL_connect returned=1 errno=0 state=error: certificate verify failed (self signed certificate in certificate chain)`

raj: hmm, which Ruby version / openssl gem? CI uses ruby:3.1 image right?

mike: yep GH image is 3.1.6, openssl 3.0.9 in the distro. local mac devs usually don't hit this.

ellie: local dev ok, only GH actions. repro in container with `bundle exec rake ci` -> same error. removing cert pin in sampleapp fixes it.

sophie: Why is sampleapp pinning a cert? I thought we only had code that used system CA stores.

ellie: it's not intentional — came from a toy helper for local mock server, committed in #345.

mike: quick workaround: set ENV `SSL_CERT_FILE` to the distro ca-bundle path in CI step. not ideal but unblocks.

raj: could we change sampleapp to detect CI and avoid pinning? or better: ship a dev-only toggle in config and docs.

sophie: agree. also add a note to the quickstart about CI gotchas. Onboarding friction increases when sample apps modify SSL behavior silently.

ellie: I'll open a small PR to remove the pin and add a comment + test. PTAL when up.

mike: also callout: our ruby SDK retry/auth parity test doesn't exercise token fetch edgecases. that made the failure noisy for teams using refreshable tokens. worth adding a CI job.

sophie: yep, add a test that simulates transient TLS errors during auth and ensure client retries the fetch with backoff.

devex-bot: docs: https://redwood-inference.internal/devex/sampleapp-onboarding -> added a CI troubleshooting note (internal link) :link: 

ellie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp-ruby/pull/412 — removes cert pin, adds CI env note, adds test for token fetch retry.

raj: looked quick — left 2 tiny nits on the test names, otherwise LGTM.

mike: approved. thanks for keeping it minimal. :thumbsup:

sophie: can we add a one-liner in the SDK changelog about parity fix for auth retry behavior? tiny release note.

ellie: good call. I'll add changelog entry and a short line in the release checklist.

mike: followup task: add a smoke CI matrix job that runs sampleapp in alpine + debian images to catch distro CA differences. filing ticket.

sophie: filing: https://tracker.internal/RED-1981 created.

ellie: thanks all — merging after CI.

mike: post-merge, we should backport the doc note to the 0.8.x branch for anyone using earlier quickstarts.

raj: noted. will do once merged.
